facts.fact: The June 2023 national open and interoperable data strategy says the government 'a élaboré' the Agenda National de Transformation Numérique 2022-2025 after extensive stakeholder consultation, and that the agenda is translated into five global objectives, four strategic orientations, three implementation levers, 25 key initiatives and 77 projects; it gives no cost.
